name: Mirmah
overview: Mirmah is a male figure from the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Shaharaim according to 1 Chronicles 8:10. Beyond this genealogical detail, there is little additional information recorded about him in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Mirmah means 'deceit' in Hebrew. This proper name is not indicated as being given by God and appears only in the genealogical record of 1 Chronicles 8:10.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Mirmah as the son of Shaharaim and also lists Hodesh as another son of Shaharaim, suggesting Mirmah had at least one brother. No further family relationships are documented beyond these.
scriptureSignificance: Mirmah's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical lineage of the tribe of Benjamin, as noted in 1 Chronicles 8:10. Such genealogical records serve to preserve the heritage and tribal identity of God's people, which is foundational for understanding the biblical narrative and God's unfolding plan through the descendants of Israel.
